test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select ‘No improvement required’.

He __have not been in__ the right mental state since 2017.
solution:
The correct answer is **'has not been in'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in **Present Perfect Continuous **tense.
 
• The subject in the given sentence is **Third Person Singular** pronoun. 
 
• So the appropriate auxiliary to be used is 'has' and not **'have'**.
 
• Hence the option **'has not been in'** is the most appropriate choice of improvement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The structure for **Present Perfect Continuous Tense**:

 
 
• **Subject + auxiliary (have/has) been + (V1 + ing)**
 
• 

 Example- **She has been working** since 2005.
